name: Singapore
intro: Explore the Garden City, a clean, high-tech metropolis at the crossroads of Southeast Asia. Singapore blends futuristic green architecture, luxury retail, and rich multi-cultural neighborhoods.
bestSeason: February to April (Lowest rainfall) & September (Formula 1 Grand Prix)
weather: Hot and humid tropical climate. Constant 31°C year-round with short daily tropical rainfall.
visaInfo: Visa required prior to travel for Indian passport holders (e-Visa).
flightDuration: Approx 5-6 hours flight from New Delhi or Mumbai.
highlights: Marvel at the avatar-like Supertree Grove at Gardens by the Bay
Swim in the world-famous infinity pool atop Marina Bay Sands
Savor Michelin-starred street food at historic hawker centers
Take a night safari through the world's first nocturnal wildlife park
